description: Inferred features and how they depend on each other. Features are heuristic groupings of files, not a declared structure, so treat them as a starting point rather than ground truth. Bounded by default (limit 50 nodes); use summaryOnly for counts + top-degree nodes.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 50, max 500). The response reports totalCount and truncated so you can tell whether you saw everything.

summaryOnly.description: When true, return counts plus top-degree nodes only (no full edge list). Prefer this for orientation.

name: feature_graph
title: Feature graph
